claims.name: Damping-scaled defect
assumptions: Computed local defect abs(d)<=eta*(1-a) including coefficient/input errors
claims.proof: Unroll e_next=a*e+d. Sum (1-a_j)*product_{l>j} a_l telescopes to 1-P_n.

claims.name: Exact bounded quantized charge
assumptions: I=cI*m and dt=ct*t are exact represented input definitions
Integer product m*t fits proved width
Every accepted prefix P=sum(m*t) fits declared range
Overflow check occurs before unsafe signed arithmetic
claims.result: Stored P equals exact represented-input sum for all accepted finite prefixes; bounded query conversion error independent of n
claims.proof: Exact multiplication/addition induction; bounded-P query evaluation
claims.implementation_status: Not implemented; ADC/timer ranges/scales and prefix-range justification open

claims.name: Finite-state all-history likelihood-contrast obstruction
assumptions: Arbitrary repeated admissible observation with fixed nonzero per-observation contrast c
Fixed query; no unbounded external time/count/storage
claims.result: No uniform fixed absolute error epsilon for all n
claims.proof: Repeated state implies periodic identical query outputs. Exact contrast grows by kp*c; choose kp*abs(c)>2epsilon.
claims.scope: Unrestricted fixed-candidate all-history contrast; not every restricted local query or indefinite estimator

claims.name: Finite-state arbitrary binary empirical-mean obstruction
claims.proof: Repeated-one prefixes of lengths i and i+kp share state. Append m zeros, choosing i<<m<<i+kp. Exact means approach0 and1 while final states/outputs match.
claims.scope: Normalization/precision floor alone cannot preserve arbitrary all-history mean; restricted semantics may differ

claims.name: Repeated transition defect composition
claims.result: L=1 and fixed positive delta gives bound E0+m*delta; separate per-transition budgets are not an all-time proof
claims.proof: Iterated recurrence; exact transformation, contraction, summable defect or other invariant needed
claims.implementation_status: No current reanchor API or transport certificate

claims.name: Relative rank screen can mask unchanged information
assumptions: cutoff=N*r and retain eigenvalues strictly greater than cutoff
claims.result: Old eigenvalue1 is no longer retained once N>=1/r; default r=1e-10 gives threshold1e10
claims.scope: Exact-arithmetic qualification policy, not proof that QR factor lost the direction

claims.name: Inductive enclosure
assumptions: All permitted transitions satisfy F(Gamma(s),u) subset Gamma(machine_transition(s,u))
claims.result: Exact reference remains enclosed for all finite prefix lengths
claims.implementation_status: A sound and nonvacuously useful Gamma/transition invariant is not yet constructed
